elements.manual_reason: No candidate box isolates the mouse cursor; it travels from the progress bar down-left to the ticket row expand chevron.
elements.label: Mouse cursor
Delivery tab focus ring (fades out after click)
Delivery panel hover states (progress-bar menu icon disappears, ticket row hover tint follows cursor)

pattern.description: Screen recording: after the tab click, the cursor glides from the delivery progress bar to the ticket row's expand chevron, with UI hover states updating along the way, setting up the next 'expand' action.
pattern.why_premium: The cursor pre-positions on the next target while the narrator says 'delivery panel', so the following click lands with no dead time and the viewer's eye is already in place.

build_hint.remotion: Cursor x/y via interpolate(frame,[start,start+18],[from,to],{easing:Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic),extrapolateRight:'clamp'}); focus ring opacity interpolate over 5 frames; hover states as frame-threshold conditionals.

notes: Low-energy event: mostly cursor travel and hover-state changes in a real screen recording. Cursor uses a manual box (end position) because no candidate isolates it. No SFX candidates.
